<edit path="tests/test_issue_templates.py">
from pathlib import Path

TEMPLATE_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / ".github" / "ISSUE_TEMPLATE"
TEMPLATES = ["bug.md", "feature.md", "question.md", "docs.md"]
BEGIN = "<!-- triage: begin -->"
END = "<!-- triage: end -->"


def triage_block(name):
    text = (TEMPLATE_DIR / name).read_text().replace("\r\n", "\n")
    assert text.count(BEGIN) == 1 and text.count(END) == 1, (
        f"{name}: expected exactly one triage begin and one triage end marker"
    )
    start = text.index(BEGIN)
    end = text.index(END) + len(END)
    assert start < end, f"{name}: triage end marker comes before begin marker"
    return text[start:end]


def test_triage_blocks_are_identical_across_issue_templates():
    blocks = {name: triage_block(name) for name in TEMPLATES}
    reference = blocks["bug.md"]
    drifted = [name for name, block in blocks.items() if block != reference]
    assert not drifted, (
        f"triage block differs from bug.md in: {', '.join(drifted)}\n"
        f"bug.md block:\n{reference}\n"
        + "\n".join(f"{n} block:\n{blocks[n]}" for n in drifted)
    )
</edit>
